مَوْقُوتٌ and ↓ مُوَقَّتٌ Determined, defined, definite, or limited, as to time. (L.) ―
-b2- وَقْتٌ مَوْقُوتٌ, and ↓ مُوَقَّتٌ , A determined, defined, definite, or limited, time. (K.) ―
-b3- إِنَّ الصَّلَاةَ كَانَتْ عَلَى المُؤْمِنِينَ كِتَابًا مَوْقُوتًا [Kur. iv. 104,] For prayer is to the believers a prescript, or an appointment, or ordinance, ordained [to be performed] in the times [thereof]. (S, K, &c.) ―
-b4- Also [مَوْقُوثٌ (see 1) and] ↓ مُوَقَّتٌ Determined, defined, or definite, as to its extreme limit, extent, or amount: (L:) both signify anything defined, definite, or limited. (Msb.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
